study type: Secondary analysis of a prospective cohort study
exposure: Planned mode of delivery (cesarean vs vaginal) for breech presentation of the first twin
First and second twins analyzed separately
cohort: 1,467 women with twin pregnancies where the first twin was in breech presentation
finding: Planned vaginal delivery was not associated with higher neonatal mortality and morbidity for either twin compared to planned cesarean delivery in twin pregnancies with a breech-presenting first twin.
mod_finding: Planned vaginal delivery was not associated with higher neonatal mortality and morbidity compared to planned cesarean delivery for either twin.
